core_motion_sentence: A precise blue gesture frames the scene, then red heat ruptures the frame into elemental performance.

timing.reduced_motion_fallback: fade + static stroke underline; no pulsing, no parallax, no fireworks

motion_primitives.name: BlueFrame
motion_primitives.description: A thin blue geometric outline draws first, implying training and composition.

motion_primitives.name: RedRupture
motion_primitives.description: A red-orange brush burst breaks through the blue frame, implying emotional release.

motion_primitives.name: ElementalBloom
motion_primitives.description: Particles cohere into a temporary elemental silhouette before dissolving.

motion_primitives.name: CopyEcho
motion_primitives.description: A glyph duplicates with a slight delay, offset, and opacity drop.

motion_primitives.name: TreasureBeat
motion_primitives.description: Small gold sparks appear on rhythm to show spell-to-resource conversion.

motion_primitives.name: StageSweep
motion_primitives.description: A wide light cone sweeps across a card or panel during reveal.

placement_card.content_rule: The title should feel like a show poster, but explanatory text stays readable and grounded.

matrix_row.content_rule: Animation should clarify the structural signal, not overwhelm row scanning.

taxonomy_node.content_rule: Nodes should feel like rehearsal cards on a studio wall.

function_demo.Detain: Freeze a motif in a blue frame before releasing it as a copied gesture.
function_demo.Override: Let red emotional force replace the current plan with a stronger expressive route.
function_demo.ConstraintField: Create a visible stage boundary so improvisation has legible shape.
function_demo.AccretionEngine: Every spell/action adds sparks until a crescendo threshold fires.

accessibility_rules: Never require color alone to distinguish blue technique from red emotion; pair color with shape or motion.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion by replacing bursts with static accents.
Keep text panels still while decorative elements move around the perimeter.
Avoid rapid strobing fireworks; use one to three large bursts instead of many small flashes.
implementation_notes: Use Prismari animations on result reveal, card hover, and taxonomy expansion only; do not animate every paragraph.
Prefer CSS transforms and opacity over layout-changing animation.
Keep particle counts low on mobile; Prismari should feel alive, not expensive.
